frozen_original.english_definition: The use of threats or pressure to make someone do something.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: တစ်စုံတစ်ဦးကို တစ်ခုခုလုပ်စေရန် ခြိမ်းခြောက်မှု သို့မဟုတ် ဖိအားပေးမှု
frozen_original.example_sentence: The agreement was invalid because it was signed under coercion.

oxford.source_sense_summary: Uncountable formal noun for compelling someone to act against their wishes through force or threats. Ordinary persuasive pressure is not automatically coercion.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.english_definition: The use of force or threats to make someone do something against their wishes.
unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: တစ်စုံတစ်ဦးအား မိမိဆန္ဒမပါဘဲ တစ်ခုခုလုပ်စေရန် အင်အားသုံးခြင်း သို့မဟုတ် ခြိမ်းခြောက်အကျပ်ကိုင်ခြင်း
unapproved_teaching_alternative.example_sentence: The worker said he signed the document under coercion.

frozen_original.english_definition: A confusing and difficult problem with no obvious solution.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: ဖြေရှင်းနည်း မထင်ရှားသည့် ရှုပ်ထွေးခက်ခဲသော ပြဿနာ
frozen_original.example_sentence: The council faced a conundrum over housing and transport costs.

oxford.source_sense_summary: Two distinct noun senses: a difficult confusing problem and a playful verbal riddle. Frozen housing/transport example illustrates the difficult-problem sense.

unapproved_teaching_alternative.burmese_meaning: ဖြေရှင်းရန် ခက်ခဲပြီး စဉ်းစားရခက်စေသော ပြဿနာ

frozen_original.english_definition: To provide additional evidence that supports a statement or account.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: ပြောဆိုချက်တစ်ခုကို ထောက်ခံသည့် အထောက်အထား ထပ်မံပေးသည်
frozen_original.example_sentence: The photographs helped corroborate the witness's account.

oxford.source_sense_summary: Formal verb: provide supporting evidence or information for a claim; transitive/intransitive and often passive. Corroboration strengthens a claim but is not necessarily conclusive proof.

frozen_original.english_definition: Belief that a claim or explanation is true.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: ပြောဆိုချက် သို့မဟုတ် ရှင်းလင်းချက်တစ်ခု မှန်ကန်သည်ဟု ယုံကြည်လက်ခံမှု
frozen_original.example_sentence: The new data gave credence to the scientist's explanation.

oxford.source_sense_summary: Two uncountable formal senses: the quality of appearing believable, and belief in a claim. Frozen 'gave credence' example can signal enhanced credibility while frozen definition describes the believer's acceptance.

frozen_original.english_definition: Respect shown by accepting another person's judgment or position.
frozen_original.burmese_meaning: အခြားသူ၏ အမြင် သို့မဟုတ် ရာထူးအဆင့်အတန်းကို လေးစား၍ ဦးစားပေးလိုက်နာမှု
frozen_original.example_sentence: Out of deference to the elders, the group waited for their opinion.

oxford.source_sense_summary: Uncountable noun for behaviour showing respect, especially in deference to someone's customs or wishes. It need not mean accepting their judgement or obeying their position.
